title: ReorderPipelineStepsRequest
description: PUT /api/pipelines/:id/steps/order body (HEL-407; contract narrowed to trunk-only by HEL-908, design.md decision 15 / non-goal waiver #2; HEL-973 makes it whole-pipeline/multi-root-aware). `stepIds` is a WHOLE-PIPELINE contract: it must be exactly a permutation of the UNION of every root's current trunk step ids (a root's trunk being the position-0 chain descending from that root), in the requested new relative order. Steps of different roots MAY be interleaved in `stepIds`; that interleaving carries no semantic weight (inter-root order is not meaningful) -- there is deliberately no `rootId` field on this request. A missing trunk id (from any root), an unexpected id (including any tail id, which this endpoint never accepts), or a duplicate all fail with 422, naming the offending ids. On success, the requested order is partitioned by each step's CURRENT owning root and each root's subsequence is relinked independently as that root's own chain: the first step of each root's subsequence becomes parentless and carries that root's own id, and each later member's parent becomes its predecessor within the SAME root's subsequence with a null root id; every trunk step's position is written as 0. Root membership is invariant under reorder by construction -- a step never moves to a different root as a side effect -- all within a single transaction; a rejected request leaves every position, parentStepId and root id unchanged. A moved trunk step's own tail (if any) follows it automatically, since a tail's parentStepId already references the trunk step's id rather than a positional slot.
